migrationRules: domain migration does not create a new canonical identity
provider replacement does not create a new canonical identity
identity replacement requires an explicit sourceCanonicalId and targetCanonicalId migration record
sourceCanonicalId and targetCanonicalId must differ for identity replacement
aliases and legacy identifiers required for continuity must be preserved
migration must declare continuity for favorites, history, progress, downloads, and aliases
migration must not silently rewrite an unknown identity
migration must preserve last-known-good until target compatibility is proven
migration may not imply deletion of the source record
deprecationRules: temporary outage alone is insufficient reason for deprecation
deprecated sources preserve canonical identity, aliases, and migration metadata
a replacement target is optional only when no safe successor exists
removal requires explicit owner authorization and a reviewed reason after deprecation
